settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII forest realism in the Hürtgen Forest, late 1944. U.S. Army infantry POV, rain, pine trunks, mud, fog, shell-scarred trees, foxholes and limited visibility. Non-graphic, subdued, exhausting rather than heroic.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Army infantry. German defenders remain clearly separate in opposing forest positions. Use long listening beats, mud, rain and navigation difficulty with only short danger moments.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person wet-forest reenactment with cold rain, pine needles, fog layers, muddy gloves, tired camera motion and realistic sound depth.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP11 — Hürtgen Forest: Lost Among the Pines
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. infantryman advances through rain-soaked forest, struggles to keep direction, shelters in a foxhole, experiences brief shelling and eventually reaches a muddy friendly line at dusk.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make navigation, cold rain and limited visibility the central experience. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Rain Through Pines
scenes.actionDescription: He follows a narrow forest track behind U.S. infantry, rifle slung.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet pine forest, U.S. sleeves, muddy trail, fog between trunks.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow wet walking. Audio: rain, boots, gear, breath.

scenes.title: Compass Check
scenes.actionDescription: He stops and opens a small compass in gloved hand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person compass, wet glove, pine needles, map edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Still compass check then glance ahead. Audio: rain, wind, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Wrong Turn
scenes.actionDescription: He turns toward one trail, hesitates, then follows friendly footprints another way.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person fork in muddy path, boot prints, fog, no enemy visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow indecisive turn then step toward prints. Audio: rain, mud suction, breath.

scenes.title: Tree Scar
scenes.actionDescription: He touches fresh splintering on a shell-scarred pine.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy glove on torn pine bark, wet wood fibers, rifle off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close tactile pause. Audio: rain, drip, distant shelling.

scenes.title: Incoming Far Off
scenes.actionDescription: Distant shelling shakes branches and he drops behind a root mound.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person root cover, needles falling, no gore, friendlies ducking nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick drop, branch debris falls. Audio: distant blasts, falling needles, breath.

scenes.title: Ears Ring
scenes.actionDescription: He remains low and presses one glove against helmet edge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person glove near helmet, wet roots, blurred pines.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still. Audio: muffled forest, breath, ringing-like dullness fading.

scenes.title: Foxhole Water
scenes.actionDescription: He steps into a shallow friendly foxhole half-filled with muddy water.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person boots entering muddy foxhole, U.S. gear and pine walls.
scenes.videoPrompt: One careful step down. Audio: water slosh, rain, breath.

scenes.title: Cold Hands
scenes.actionDescription: He rubs wet gloved hands together for warmth.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet gloves, mud-splashed sleeves, rifle resting against wall.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet hand rubbing. Audio: rain, fabric, distant guns.

scenes.title: Move Again
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs out and follows squad deeper through trees.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy rise, U.S. soldiers ahead in fog.
scenes.videoPrompt: Heavy climb and slow walk. Audio: boots, gear, rain.

scenes.title: Wire in the Ferns
scenes.actionDescription: He spots old wire and steps carefully around it.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet ferns, wire obstacle, boot paused, rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Downward look and careful side step. Audio: rain, metal faintly clink, breath.

scenes.title: Empty Clearing
scenes.actionDescription: He waits at clearing edge scanning fog with no target visible.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person foggy clearing, rifle low at side, dark tree line opposite.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still scan. Audio: rain easing, distant shots, breath.

scenes.title: Short Crossing
scenes.actionDescription: He makes one short run across the clearing to friendly trees.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy sprint, U.S. cover ahead, weapon offset.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast dash then stop. Audio: boots, breath, gear.

scenes.title: Friendly Marker
scenes.actionDescription: He spots a clear U.S. friendly position marker and lowers shoulders.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy tree line, recognizable friendly marker, U.S. helmets in cover.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow approach and exhale. Audio: drip, wind, breath.

scenes.title: Dusk Canteen
scenes.actionDescription: He drinks from a canteen under darkening pines.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person canteen, wet sleeve, blue-gray dusk forest.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet drink. Audio: water, distant artillery, wind.

scenes.title: Pines at Night
scenes.actionDescription: He settles into a foxhole and looks up at black pine silhouettes.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low foxhole, dark pines against clouded sky, rifle resting beside him.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt and hold. Audio: rain drops, wind, tired breathing. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous U.S. infantryman in the Hürtgen Forest, late 1944.
characters.mainOutfit: U.S. Army field jacket, M1 helmet, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Army. German defenders remain separate and mostly unseen. Preserve rain, mud, cold and fatigue continuity.

atmosphereAssets.title: Forest Track
atmosphereAssets.description: Rain-soaked pine trails, mud and fog.

atmosphereAssets.title: Roots and Foxholes
atmosphereAssets.description: Shell-scarred roots and muddy U.S. foxholes.

atmosphereAssets.title: Clearing and Forward Line
atmosphereAssets.description: Foggy clearing and U.S. defensive tree line.
